CREATE TABLE "public"."application" (
  "appliedAt" timestamptz,
  "coverLetterId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "followUpAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobId" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "resumeVariantId" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'SAVED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "application_status_check_648bf800" CHECK ("status" IN ('SAVED', 'PREPARING', 'APPLIED', 'FOLLOW_UP', 'INTERVIEW', 'REJECTED', 'OFFER', 'WITHDRAWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."company" (
  "careerPageUrl" text,
  "city" text,
  "country" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "logoUrl" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."coverLetter" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "editedContent" text,
  "generatedContent" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."job" (
  "companyId" text,
  "contentHash" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "employmentType" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz,
  "externalId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "location" text,
  "longitude" float8,
  "normalizedTitle" text,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz,
  "requirements" text,
  "seniority" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "workplaceType" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "job_employmentType_check_6282316d" CHECK ("employmentType" IN ('FULL_TIME', 'PART_TIME', 'CONTRACT', 'INTERNSHIP', 'TEMPORARY', 'FREELANCE', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "job_seniority_check_a8fc7737" CHECK ("seniority" IN ('INTERN', 'JUNIOR', 'MID', 'SENIOR', 'LEAD', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "job_workplaceType_check_0ecb1ac0" CHECK ("workplaceType" IN ('ONSITE', 'HYBRID', 'REMOTE', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."jobMatch" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "explanation" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobId" text NOT NULL,
  "missingSkills" json,
  "modelVersion" text,
  "partialMatches" json,
  "score" int4 NOT NULL,
  "searchProfileId" text,
  "strongMatches" json,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."jobSkill" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "importance" text DEFAULT 'MEDIUM' NOT NULL,
  "jobId" text NOT NULL,
  "required" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "skillId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "jobSkill_importance_check_916cf5bb" CHECK ("importance" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."profile" (
  "city" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "headline" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "remotePreference" text,
  "seniority" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "summary" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "yearsOfExperience" float8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "profile_remotePreference_check_8dc8bb70" CHECK ("remotePreference" IN ('ONSITE', 'HYBRID', 'REMOTE', 'UNKNOWN')),
  CONSTRAINT "profile_seniority_check_a8fc7737" CHECK ("seniority" IN ('INTERN', 'JUNIOR', 'MID', 'SENIOR', 'LEAD', 'UNKNOWN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resume" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isMaster" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "originalFileUrl" text,
  "summary" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resumeEducation" (
  "degree" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resumeId" text NOT NULL,
  "school" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resumeExperience" (
  "company" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "endDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resumeId" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resumeSkill" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resumeId" text NOT NULL,
  "skillId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."resumeVariant" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "editedContent" json,
  "generatedContent" json,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobId" text NOT NULL,
  "resumeId" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."savedJob" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "jobId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."searchProfile" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "employmentTypes" text[] NOT NULL,
  "excludeKeywords" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "jobTitles" text[] NOT NULL,
  "keywords" text[] NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "location" text,
  "longitude" float8,
  "minimumMatchScore" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "radiusKm" int4,
  "seniority" text[] NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "workplaceTypes" text[] NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_employmentTypes_check_24e00a30" CHECK ("employmentTypes"::text[] <@ ARRAY['FULL_TIME', 'PART_TIME', 'CONTRACT', 'INTERNSHIP', 'TEMPORARY', 'FREELANCE', 'UNKNOWN']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_employmentTypes_elem_not_null_15e27405" CHECK (array_position("employmentTypes", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_excludeKeywords_elem_not_null_cb7d0216" CHECK (array_position("excludeKeywords", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_jobTitles_elem_not_null_6f570ae8" CHECK (array_position("jobTitles", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_keywords_elem_not_null_f10c6f3f" CHECK (array_position("keywords", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_seniority_check_9f513e38" CHECK ("seniority"::text[] <@ ARRAY['INTERN', 'JUNIOR', 'MID', 'SENIOR', 'LEAD', 'UNKNOWN']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_seniority_elem_not_null_ada4d838" CHECK (array_position("seniority", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_workplaceTypes_check_b66b8403" CHECK ("workplaceTypes"::text[] <@ ARRAY['ONSITE', 'HYBRID', 'REMOTE', 'UNKNOWN']::text[]),
  CONSTRAINT "searchProfile_workplaceTypes_elem_not_null_a611bf35" CHECK (array_position("workplaceTypes", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."searchProfileSkill" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "searchProfileId" text NOT NULL,
  "skillId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."skill" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "normalizedName" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."userSkill" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "level" text DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' NOT NULL,
  "skillId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "yearsExperience" float8,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "userSkill_level_check_b982d5d6" CHECK ("level" IN ('BEGINNER', 'INTERMEDIATE', 'ADVANCED', 'EXPERT', 'UNKNOWN'))
)
